wasm.reason: The builder's Wasm canvas cannot link `material3-a2ui`, which is published only as an Android AAR. This catalog's renderer runtime (a2ui-ui-builder-renderer) draws the design through this repository's Compose Multiplatform port of the same release instead: the same library source, not the AAR the stickers are rendered with. Where that runtime is not published, every component draws as a named placeholder.

native.reason: The exported A2UI payload drawn by `material3-a2ui` through Robolectric — the same lane, host and catalog that produce this repository's stickers.
